Expert in Multi Dimensional Bodywork & Energy Work Education helping massage therapists so they can heal smarter not harder using revolutionary techniques to create the greatest results with their clients using the least amount of effort.  

Julie has been a massage therapist for 21 years, equine massage therapist, certified herbal consultant and has studied osteopathy for 20 years alongside one of her best friends.  She has worked on and created dramatic changes in hundreds of bodies.  She enthusiastically teaches her own massage therapy courses live and online as well as energy work classes, Access Bars.
